fichas.title: Water Supply and Drainage Symbols
fichas.summary: Reference chart showing plan and elevation conventions for drainage pipes and appliances, water-supply fixtures, wastewater treatment equipment, hydrants, and fire-protection systems. Drainage symbols include pipe types and directions, cleaning openings, diameter changes, traps, separators, backflow devices, and shafts.
uses: Interpreting water-supply and drainage symbols in architectural drawings
